name: Strix Halo 8060S (Vulkan RADV (Mesa 25.1.6)) Qwen3-30B-A3B UD-Q4_K_XL: pp512 at depth 4096
unit: tok/s (pp512 at primed depth, per-request batch-1, 5-run average)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Strix Halo HomeLab wiki llama.cpp performance page, lhl, re-fetched 2026-10-16). Hardware: Framework Desktop, AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo) + Radeon 8060S iGPU (gfx1151), 128GB LPDDR5x unified memory. Model: unsloth Qwen3-30B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf. Backend: Vulkan RADV (Mesa 25.1.6). llama-bench -fa 1 --mmap 0 -ngl 999 -ub 1024 -d 4096, five repeats, average tok/s. prompt-processing (pp512) measured at primed context depth 4096; per-request batch-1, not aggregate across concurrent requests. The wiki's zero-depth HIP tg128 (130.33) is the same shape as, but a different run from, the short-context HIP rocWMMA summary (58.5 tg128) already recorded in strix-halo-8060s-qwen3-30b-a3b-udq4-hip-tg128 — different llama.cpp build and backend flags, so both are kept.
notes: Per-request batch-1. Depth is the primed context (-d) before the pp512/tg128 measurement, not the generated length.
